verdict.rationale: An official SDK is a fair question for a SaaS code-review platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no official SDK or client library in any language. The OpenAPI spec probe and the API mention in coderabbit-comm-9 are developer building blocks, and the official CLI belongs to a separate story, so none of them count as SDK support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
